# EloqData

> EloqData develops distributed databases built on a shared Data Substrate architecture, including Redis-compatible EloqKV, MongoDB-compatible EloqDoc, and MySQL-compatible EloqSQL.

Use the linked product and compatibility documentation for supported features. Benchmark and cost results describe the workload, hardware, pricing date, and durability settings in the individual report; they are not guarantees for every deployment.

## Products and documentation

- [EloqKV](https://www.eloqdata.com/product/eloqkv): Redis-compatible key-value database with NVMe-backed storage options.
- [EloqKV architecture](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/introduction): Data Substrate, transactions, persistence, and storage architecture.
- [EloqKV quick start](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/quick-start): Installation and initial usage.
- [Redis command compatibility](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/kvstore_compatibility): Check supported commands before migration.
- [Redis client compatibility](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/client_compatibility): Client and connection guidance.
- [EloqDoc](https://www.eloqdata.com/product/eloqdoc): MongoDB-compatible document database.
- [EloqDoc compatibility](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqdoc/compatibility): Supported MongoDB features and limitations.
- [EloqSQL](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqsql/introduction): MySQL-compatible distributed SQL database.
- [Product editions](https://www.eloqdata.com/product-comparison): Product edition capabilities.
- [EloqData on GitHub](https://github.com/eloqdata): Source repositories and project documentation.
